verdict.rationale: AiPrise's own docs say users can build fully custom verification workflows with AiPrise APIs, and that screening runs through one API, so a first-party public API exists. The evidence is only high-level marketing and docs lines: no endpoint reference, auth model or coverage of dashboard functions (flow editing, case routing) is shown. The OpenAPI probe found no machine-readable spec at any candidate path, though docs are LLM-readable via llms.txt. Missing for 10: endpoint-level API reference evidence, a published OpenAPI spec, evidence the API covers case management and configuration rather than just verification, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Build fully custom verification workflows using AiPrise APIs for maximum control and flexibility.
Screen adverse media, PEPs, sanctions, and watchlists in real time - all through one API.
